summary: @servicetitan/folder-lint preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: On `npm install`, the package's `preinstall` script runs an obfuscated launcher (`setup.mjs`) that downloads the Bun JavaScript runtime v1.3.13 from the oven-sh/bun GitHub releases, extracts it to a temporary directory, marks it executable, and uses it to run a shipped 727KB Bun-compiled bundle `math_init.js`. If `bun` is already present on PATH, the download step is skipped and `math_init.js` is executed directly. Both `setup.mjs` and `math_init.js` are heavily obfuscated (obfuscator.io-style `_0xXXXX` identifiers, rotated string/number arrays with an array-shift decoder), so the payload's behavior is not statically inspectable and is only executable under the freshly-fetched alternate runtime. The package advertises itself as an ESLint folder-schema configuration helper (`main:./dist/index.js`), a purpose that has no legitimate need for a second JavaScript runtime or an opaque 727KB blob at install time. The auto-executing install-time surface therefore does not match the advertised library surface, consistent with a compromised or hijacked publish under the @servicetitan scope.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
